title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitives and enums. Contract v1 (ADR-001).

utc_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC, must end in Z. Offsets are rejected so every stored time is unambiguous. The pattern enforces shape; format enforces a real calendar date and time, so validators must enable format checking.

decimal_string.description: Exact decimal as a string. Never a float.

surface_status.description: Shared UI state. Empty coverage is not no_material_change.

research_action.description: Research actions only. Never a trade instruction.

horizon.description: Supported horizons. Intraday is excluded until feeds and latency are established.

feed.description: Always explicit; never rely on a subscription-dependent default.
